fusions.name: Reeking Burst
fusions.desc: Flares a ring of links, dealing 8 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles, knocking each back 2 tiles and stripping 15% of their armour for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Spiteful Flick
fusions.desc: A strike that deals 3 damage and makes the target [Poisoned] for 1 damage a second for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Bristled Reprisal
fusions.desc: For 8 seconds, 70% of the damage you take is dealt back to whoever dealt it.

fusions.name: Lasting Stench
fusions.desc: Your afflictions take hold on an enemy that is immune to them. You carry 8% poison resistance for as long as you carry it.
